patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM and SysAid share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ivanti Neurons for ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does n” rather than SysAid's shape. Choose SysAid only if your buying job matches “ITSM / service desk — Professional published ~$89/agent/mo (medium confidence; quote-led p” rather than Ivanti Neurons for ITSM's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is shaped for Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No whereas SysAid is shaped for ITSM / service desk — Professional published ~$89/agent/mo (medium con. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM and SysAid share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 / Freshservice 8.4.; SysAid is ITSM / service desk — Professional published ~$89/agent/mo (medium confidence; quote-led page); Enterprise custom min 20 agents; free trial..
- Company-size focus: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM (mid-market, enterprise) vs SysAid (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM — No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU; SysAid — Pricing page is quote-led — $89 Professional is medium-confidence, not Freshservice Starter certainty.

Limitations — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4); SysAid: Pricing page is quote-led — $89 Professional is medium-confidence, not Freshservice Starter certainty; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4).

Poor-fit cases: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU · SysAid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing page is quote-led — $89 Professional is medium-confidence, not Freshservice Starter certainty · Avoid Ivanti Neurons for ITSM if you actually need SysAid's motion (ITSM / service desk — Professional published ~$89/agent/mo (medium confidence; q)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
